title: Monticello Country Ballooning
specs: Only all-inclusive package in the area including tax, photos, and celebratory toast
Padded floors and tanks in baskets for soft landings
Experienced pilots with FAA commercial balloon pilot licenses
Multiple launch sites near Charlottesville chosen daily based on wind conditions
Afternoon flights require passengers under age 70, in good physical health, and able to climb into basket unassisted
No age restrictions on morning flights
Children under age 8 generally not recommended
Weight restrictions: combined weight for couple max 350 lbs for regular flights; groups over 400 lbs must contact operator
includes: Traditional celebratory toast (champagne or beverage of choice) included
Transportation to and from launch site included with private flights if staying locally
gap: Exact price per person not stated
blurb: Guests participate in hot air balloon flights typically lasting 45-60 minutes, with total experience time about 2.5-3 hours including transport, setup, flight, and pack-up. Flights occur mostly at sunrise or about 2 hours before sunset, with multiple launch sites near Charlottesville chosen based on wind conditions. The company emphasizes safety, quality, and experienced pilots with FAA commercial balloon pilot licenses.
extraNote: Flights subject to weather conditions; operator may cancel any flight at any time · 50% cancellation fee if cancellation less than one week before flight · 100% cancellation fee if cancellation less than 72 hours before flight for any reason · Meeting sites usually within 10-15 minutes from where guests are staying in Charlottesville area; exact launch site varies by wind conditions and cannot be predetermined. · Year-round, with busiest seasons spring and fall
